title: WORLD4 UPDATED wings Auto Mine Auto Mob Auto Sell
features:
1. Autofarm

Auto Farm system where you can choose whether the Script farms from above, under, or stays off.
You can select all Ore Type fine tune the settings:


– Adjustable distance to ores
– Custom mining speed
– Custom teleport delay
– Custom movement (tween) speed
– Automatic swinging of the pickaxe
– Smart check to skip ores already being mined

Combat

Combat works similarly to Autofarm, with attack modes (Off/Above/Under) and a mob selector.
Set your preferred combat distance, and adjust the movement speed for fighting.

World 2 [Forgotten Kingdom Island 2] Specials

Includes lava-safe farming and combat modes (Off, Skip Rock/Mob, or auto-switch to Above)

2. Settings (Webhook & Priority)

Webhook:
Set which ores trigger Discord alerts, enter your webhook URL, define how often stats are sent.

Ore Priority:
Each ore gets a priority rating (0–5). Higher priority ores are always mined first.

3. Player

A set of movement and safety tools:
– Noclip, Fly, Infinite Jump
– Custom walk speed, jump power, gravity
– Mod detection with auto-server-hop
– Teleports to important locations in both worlds
– Open the Forge
– Redeem all Code

4. Purchase

Everything related to items and potions:
– Buy and auto-use potions
– Auto-buy system with thresholds
– Inventory scanner
– Auto-sell selected ores/materials with adjustable amounts
– Auto-fix for broken shop sessions

5. Spoof

Visual spoofing tools:
– Fake level
– Fake money
– Custom spoof type (Static, Custom Value, Legit-Looking Random)

6. Visuals

ESP + 40 options for player/mob visibility, chams, fullbright, world lighting, fog settings, and more.

7. Settings (Config & Advanced)

Advanced tools for performance and customization:
– Save/load configs
– Change menu key and theme
– Server-hop, low-server hop, rejoin
– Auto-inject on teleport
– Extreme FPS boost mode
– Optional black screen
– Anti-AFK
– Fully destroy/unload the UI
